body.statement: There is an absolute constant \(C<\infty\) such that for every \(n,d,K\), \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_{d,K}}E_{P^n}[(\widehat V_{\mathrm{ER}}-V^\star(P))^2]\le C\min\{1,u(d,K)/n\}\), uniformly over unknown \(p_x\), unknown \(e_{ax}\) satisfying only \(e_{ax}\ge1/(2K)\), null cells, exact ties, and boundary means.
body.justification: This proves a full-class baseline with absolute constants, no oracle knowledge of masses or logging probabilities, and no upper balance restriction on logging.
body.gap: NguyenBarrettJun2025HAVER conditions on externally supplied arm counts; the result here controls random causal cell occupancy and aggregation over arbitrary group masses.
body.consumer: The estimator gives an immediately implementable attainable-value error guarantee for multi-arm causal forests and related treatment-targeting systems.
